translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: SAN LUCAS
book.title: An alhua’ cau thuchath c’al an t’ocat inic Lucas

content: A Jesús in t’iloxnal an eb t’ocattalab

Lej tamcunale yan i mil i inicchic, ani lej q’uits’c’omanal ma q’uets’áxchic c’al in acan. Tam a Jesús in ucha’ in exobalilchic: ―Ca t’aja’chic ti cuenta yab quit c’ambiyat c’al an fariseochic, cum eb t’ocatq’ui ani in exobchixtal u tsinat t’ojnal ejtil an c’ac’chixtalab c’al an c’oye.
Jahua’ in tsinat t’ajal an inic ne’ets ca tala’ tejhua’methanchat pil a q’uicha, ani jahua’ in tsinat tsalpayal tin ichich ne’ets ca tso’obnanchat pil a q’uicha.

Jahua’ tata’chic a tsinat t’iloxnal ta cuetemtal ne’ets quit tala’ tso’obnanchat c’al an inicchic. Jahua’ a cue’ ulal alta ta q’uima’ c’al an hui’leb maputh ne’ets quit thajat t’iloxnanchat jun ti ca tala’ ats’an c’al patal an inicchic.
Jita’ ca ts’ejna
Ja’ubchic, nan tu uchal yab ca ts’ejna’ a at inic, cum expith in ejtohual ti tsemthanchi a inictal ani expith ja.
Nan tu uchalchic ca ts’ejna’ a Dios, cum jaja’ in ejtohual ti tixc’anchi a ejattal ani jaye max ti jolou ti al am pulic tsemla. Ojni’ jaja’ jats ca ts’ejna’.
An nujul in nujuhual bo’ i tsacam ts’itsin c’al tsab i tsacam tumin. Cum a Dios lej beletnom ni jayq’ui’ yab in uc’chiyal an tsacam ts’itsin.

Ani jaja’ ti co’onchalits ajith tin junchictal a xi’il ta oc’. Cum a Dios lej beletnom, jaxtam yab ca ts’ejna’ jant’o quit t’ajchin c’al a at inic. Jaja’ ti tsu’tal a cua’al a lej c’athpich exbath ani yab ejtil an tsacam ts’itsin.
Jitats quin olna’ a Cristo c’al an inicchic
Patal jitats tiquin olnanchi u bij c’al in at inic, nana’ jaye ne’ets cu olnanchi im bij c’al an ángelchic axi tihua’ ti eb c’al a Dios. Nana’its pel tin Juntal patal an inicchic.
Jitats tiquin tsinc’onchi u bij c’al in at inic, nana’ jaye ne’ets cu tsinc’onchi im bij c’al an ángelchic tihua’ ti eb c’al a Dios.
Jitats tiquin quithab cahuiliy nana’ tin Juntal patal an inicchic ne’ets ca ejtohuat ca paculanchat. Jitats quin quithab cahuiliy an Espíritu Santo yab ne’ets ca ejtohuat ca paculanchat.
Tam tit binathits quit ts’ejca c’al i ts’ejcom cau ax ti al an tiyopan ani jaye c’al i oc’lecchic, yab quit tsalpaxin tin cuenta jant’o ne’ets ca ucha’ o jant’ini’ ti ne’ets quit toc’tsin.
Ma tameq’ui an Espíritu Santo ne’ets ti pitha’ an cau jant’o ca ulu.
An ricotalab
Jun i inic axi taja’ al an mulcunel in ucha’ a Jesús: ―Exobchix, ca ucha’ u ebchal abal tiquim pitha’ jahua’ bijithits cu bats’u c’al an they jilchith c’alab.
Toc’tsin a Jesús: ―Pay’lom, yab u ey tin ts’ejcanchix ani tim buc’chix c’al tata’chic.
Uchanaye c’al a Jesús: ―Ca lej taja’ ti cuenta yab ca huat’ath c’a’inchi an c’alab axi teje’ tsabal, cum yab c’al ja ti ne’ets ca co’oy a ejattal it ejatlith c’al a Dios.
Tam a Jesús in olna’ i jalpith cau antse’: ―C’uajatac jun i rico inic in cua’al lej yan i t’ayablab lej hualith.
Xe’ets in lej tsalpayal ju’ta ti quin tala’ thaya’ an hualilab, cum yab ne’ets quin tala’ ac’na’ an huilte’chic ax in cua’al.
Tam in cuete’ ulu tin ichich antse’: Ma xohue’ u exla’its jahua’ ne’ets cu t’aja’. Ne’ets cu ijca’ u huilte’ilchic ani cu ts’ejca’ axi más pulic. Tats ne’ets cu tala’ thaya’ an hualilab.
C’al xi yantalom hualilab ne’ets cu huat’a’ yan i tamub coyolq’ui ani culbelq’ui. Ne’ets tin c’apupulq’ui ani ne’ets tin uts’uts’ulq’ui, in ulu.

Ma tamna’ ojni’ tauna c’al a Dios antse’: Tata’ ojni’ it macu’ a tsalap, cum ne’ets quit tsemets axe’ xi acal. ¿Tam jita’ ne’ets quin tabatna’ ax a cua’al yan jant’o thayach? Antsana’ ti conoyat c’al a Dios.
Pel i macu’ in tsalap jitats quin thaya’ yan jant’o jahua’ hua’ats teje’ tsabal quin cuete’ c’alna’q’ui ani ni jant’o tam c’alab yab in cua’al thayach tihua’ ti eb c’al a Dios, in ulu a Jesús.
U beletnom a Dios c’al in tsacamilchic
Taley a Jesús in ucha’ in exobalilchic: ―Jaxtam nan tu uchalchic yab quit xe’tsin tsalpopol c’al an c’apnel ani c’al an toltom.
In exbath a ejattal lej c’athpich yab ejtil in exbath an c’apnel, ani in exbath a inictal lej c’athpich yab ejtil in exbath an toltom.

Ca t’aja’ ti cuentachic an c’ojchic abal yab u om, ani yab u c’ojol, ani yab in thayal jant’o ti al an huilte’. Bel u c’apulchic, cum expith c’al a Dios u pijchab. A exbath tata’chic lej c’athpich yab ejtil in exbath an ts’itsin.
Aba ma ca lej xijc’ath luba’ ta ba’ quit t’ec’atme ts’ejel metro, ni abal jay yab ne’ets ca ejtou.
Max yab a ejtohualchic ca t’aja’ jahua’ yab lej q’uibat, jolat quit xe’tsin tsalpopol c’al jahua’ lej q’uibat.

Ca t’aja’chic ti cuenta jant’ini’ tu puhuel an huits. Yab ja tin ebal abal u t’ojnal ani yab tin ebal max u huichalac abal quin ts’ejca’ tim ba’. Nan tu uchalchic abal an ts’ale Salomón c’al patal in ts’alat toltomil yab im baju in alabental ejtil an huits.

C’al a Dios jats tu ts’ejcanal an huits c’athpich alabel. Ti jun a q’uicha ejate ani ti junaque a q’uicha tsemenequits ani ca chican. Cum más a exbathchic c’al a Dios, más ne’ets ti pitha’chic an toltom. Tata’chic ojni’ yabaye a alhua’ belamalchic a Dios.
Yabats quit t’e’piplats c’al an c’apnel ani c’al an uts’nel.
Axi yab u exlom c’al a Dios jats axi xe’ets tsalpopol c’al jahua’ teje’ tsabal. Tata’chic yab antsana’ ta ca t’aja’, cum a cua’al a Tata ti eb ax in tso’obits patal jahua’ a yejenchal.
Expith ca junini’ jilchichic a Dios quin t’aja’ ti Ts’ale ta ichich, ani tamna’ jaja’ ne’ets ti pitha’chic patal jahua’ ca yejenchi teje’ tsabal.
An c’alab axi ti eb
Tata’chic ejtil it tsacam cuenel i oveja axi tu c’alchic nana’. Yab quit jiq’ueychic, cum a Tata ti eb in le’ quin t’aja’ ti Ts’ale ta ichich.

Ca nuju jahua’ a cua’al ani ca pitha’ an tumin an ts’ejhuantal. Ca t’aja’chic alhua’ abal ca co’oy a c’al tihua’ ti eb c’al a Dios. Jahua’ tihua’ hua’ats ti eb ojni’ yab ne’ets ca ejtohuat ca cue’eyat c’al i cue’ ani yab ne’ets ca ejtohuat ca c’apts’uhuat c’al i thum.
An c’alab axi tata’chic a tsu’talits lej c’athpich huinat alhua’, jats ne’ets ca junini’ tsalapna’ ta ichich.
Cu c’uajiy ts’ejcacath
Quit c’uajiychic lej ts’ejcacath a tsalap ejtil axi pel i beletnanchix ata.
In junini’ aychal ca huichiy in amu axi c’alnec quin tsu’u an tomquintalab. Tocat ca ulcan ani ca tauna, thubatq’ui ne’ets quin japchi an hui’leb.
Max im putuhualits c’al in uchbil ne’ets ca lej culbe tam ca huichiy in amu. Lej chubax nan tu uchalchic abal an amu jaja’ lej putat ne’ets quin ts’ejcacanchi an c’apnel am beletnanchix ata.
Ojni’ ne’ets ca lej culbe am beletnanchix ata max ets’ey lej ts’ejcacathits tam ca ulcan in amu, max ts’ejel acal o max tam chuthelaquits.
Ca t’aja’ ti cuentachic jun i thabal ata axi otsanchat in q’uima’ ani cue’chinenec. Max in tso’obnamalac jahua’ tam hora ne’etsac ca chich an cue’, yabac huayamath ani yab cue’chinenecac.
Tata’chic quit c’uajiy lej ts’ejcacath, cum nana’ tin Juntal patal an inicchic ne’ets quin chi’pin lej jun athic tam yabchic a t’ilt’om.
Jita’ pel i abatnanchix pututh ani jita’ iba
Tam conoyab a Jesús c’al a Pedro: ―¿Ajatic, tu olchamal axe’ xi jalpith cau expith huahua’ ax tu exobalil o a olchamal jaye patal axi muthat teje’?
Toc’tsin an Ajatic: ―An t’ojnal axi pututh ani tsalpath jats axi ne’ets ca punuhuat ti abatnanchix c’al xi q’ue’at in t’ojnalil an amulab, ma quin ulu jahua’ tam hora ca pijchinchat.
Tam ca chich in amu, tam ne’ets ca lej culbe nixe’ xi abatnanchix max im putuhual c’al in uchbil.
Lej chubax nan tu uchalchic abal jats jaja’ axi ne’ets ca punuhuat ti ts’ale abatnanchix c’al patal jahua’ in cua’al in amu.

Ani max yab pututh ne’ets quin tsalpay abal in amu ne’ets ca ohuey abal ca chich, ani hualam tocat ne’ets quin othna’ ax in abatnalchic ani an cuthinelchic. Tocat ca xe’tsin c’apupulq’ui ani uts’uts’ulq’ui, ma ne’ets ca uts’alin.

Max antsana’ ca elchin c’al in amu tam ca chi’pin jun athic tam yab u aychab, tam ne’ets ca c’athpich yajchiquiyat ani ca c’uajiy jolbibith ejtil axi q’ue’atchic an inicchic yab pututh c’al in uchbil.
An abatnanchix ax in exlanchits in culbetal in amu ani yab in t’ajchamal, jats ne’ets ca c’athpich yajchiquiyat.

Axi yab in exlanchi, huachic ne’ets ca yajchiquiyat max yab in t’ajchamal. Jitats pithnenec hue’ yan in uchbil, antsana’ ti quim bina’ an cuenta hue’ yan. Jitats pithnenec lej yan in uchbil, antsana’ ti quim bina’ an cuenta lej yan.
I tomolnaxtalab tin ebal a Cristo
In che’nec teje’ tsabal ani u ts’at’elilchic ne’ets ca lej yajchiquiyat ejtil max ca huat’ba al i c’amal, ani u lej le’ max xohue’ exomaquits.
Pel u uchbil cu lej yajchicna’ne an yajchictalab, ani jats c’al tu junini’ co’oyab u ichich ma ta ca tala’ putunits nixe’ xi yajchictalab.
Yab ca q’uibts’oth tsalpaychic max an inic ne’ets ca c’uajiychic jun ejet expith tin ebal abal nan in che’nec teje’ tsabal. Tu uchalchic abal ne’ets ca tomolnáxin tin ebal nana’ u ey.
Ma xohue’its i q’uimath ne’ets ca cuete’ tomolnáxin jun c’al xi jun. Jun ti hua’ats bo’ i ejattalab hualam ox quin tomolna’ axi tsab.

Ne’ets ca tomolna i cuitol c’al in tata ani i tatalab c’al in cuitolil. Ne’ets ca tomolna i ts’ic’ach c’al in mim ani i mimlab c’al in ts’ic’achil. Ne’ets ca tomolna i al’iblab ts’ic’ach c’al in uxum iyam ani i uxum iyamlab c’al in al’ib ts’ic’ach.
An tsu’bixtalabchic
Uchane an mulcunel c’al a Jesús: ―Tam ca tsu’uchic an tocou ti otsel q’uicha, tamna’ a ulalchic abal ne’ets ca ulitsits an ab tihua’, ani chubax u ulel.
Tam ca juchun an ic’ tal alal, tamna’ a ulalchic abal ne’ets ca lej cubiyits an c’ac’al, ani chubax u cubel.

Tata’chic ojni’ it lej eb tsalpathq’ui ani yab it lejat tsalpath ta ejattal. A tso’obchic an tsu’bixtalab c’al an ab ani c’al an c’ac’al, ani ma ni hue’ yab a tso’ob an tsu’bixtalab axi nan u t’ajal c’al in tsap a Dios ti eb.
Ca luba’ ca ts’ejcanchat an cau c’al an tomolnax
¿Jale’ yab a tso’obnalitschic quit ts’ejcacan c’al a ichich c’al a Dios?

Ca t’aja’chic ti cuenta max it junax ne’ets c’al a tomolnaxil abal quit ts’ejcanchat i cau c’al an oc’lecchic, in tomnalac ca cuete’ ts’ejca’chic an cau ti bel. Tam jaja’ yab ne’ets ti ne’tha’ c’al an ts’ejcom cau, ani yab ne’ets quit baliyat al an huic’axte’.

Nan tu uchalchic abal max yab ca cuete’ ts’ejca’ c’al a tomolnaxil an cau ani max quit baliyat al an huic’axte’, yab ne’ets quit thubat caltha ma ta ca quithat jalbiyits jahua’ it uchanits ca jalbiy c’al an ts’ejcom cau.
